page_new.excerpt: # SLI / SLO and Error Budgets **Identity.** SLI/SLO and Error Budgets; family Security, isolation and operational architecture; kind operations-pattern; priority core. **Decision question.** Should service health be governed by user-visible indicators, objectives and an explicit error budget? **Good-fit conditions.** An SLI measures a meaningful journey; SLO target/window are agreed; error budget drives action. **Hard contraindications.** Reject when metrics are not user-visible, when targets are arbitrary, or when budget breach has no consequence. **Competing alternative.** Synthetic checks or raw infrastructure metrics alone.
